_comment: Bellevue 116th camera with all four paper-derived extensions enabled:
E1 use_pce_queue        - PCE-weighted Queue_Length (Wei limitation B-S1)
E3 use_discharge_green  - Green_Time = queue / saturation flow (Wei Eq. 16)
min_green_time is lowered from 30 s to 10 s here, and this is deliberate rather
than incidental: with a 30 s floor the discharge model cannot express itself at
all on this footage, because the observed queues (queue_capacity 3-4) discharge
in well under 30 s at a 0.5 PCE/s saturation flow, so every cycle would clamp to
the floor. Being able to ask for LESS green than a fixed band table allows is
part of what E3 buys. The consequence is that E3 cannot be compared to the band
baseline with the timing range held constant; bellevue_116th_tits_scoring.json
keeps the bands and the 30 s floor so E1+E2+E4 can be attributed separately.
saturation_flow_rate 0.5 PCE/s = 1800 PCE/h, the conventional per-lane saturation
flow. It is a physical parameter and was NOT tuned to produce a result.
Geometry, alpha, saturation counts, queue capacities, bands, yellow and
starvation_limit are copied unchanged from config/bellevue_116th.json.
